name: Activated Bamboo Charcoal Air Purifying Bags (4-Pack)
shortDescription: Chemical-free linen pouches filled with high-surface-area activated bamboo charcoal that absorbs odors and moisture.
longDescription: The Activated Bamboo Charcoal Air Purifying Bags 4-Pack provides a completely natural, fragrance-free air filtration solution for bedrooms, closets, shoe cabinets, and newly painted rooms. Each breathable natural linen sachet contains two hundred grams of pure Moso bamboo charcoal kilned at high temperatures exceeding eight hundred degrees Celsius. This specialized pyrolysis process activates millions of microscopic pores that capture volatile organic compounds (VOCs), trapped humidity, pet dander odors, and airborne mold spores through natural van der Waals adsorption. Once retired, the charcoal is an excellent organic soil conditioning mulch that enriches potted houseplants. An all-natural deodorizing solution that keeps indoor environments clean, fresh, and delightfully breathable for healthy living.
